excluded_by_design: the console transcripts (.out) and raw /usr/bin/time reports (.time), which carry absolute paths

observations.memory_mapping_took_effect: 21,846 major page faults on the shortest-path scan against 0-8 on the three runs that read no large artifact. Major faults are pages served from disk, which is what a mapped read produces and a resident read does not.
observations.peak_rss_includes_the_mapped_table: 11.23 GiB peak, of which 10.03 GiB is the mapped artifact. ru_maxrss counts file-backed resident pages, so this figure does not distinguish them from anonymous memory; the operator's system monitor, which excludes page cache, showed roughly 6.7 GB peak falling to 5.9 GB. The two are consistent only if the table was mapped.
observations.the_whole_table_was_read: audit_sp_reachability read 10,777,264,128 bytes (10.78 GB) against an artifact of 10,764,644,300 bytes (10.76 GB). Independent of the sidecar's num_pairs check, which reaches the same conclusion from the tensor length rather than from disk traffic.

provenance_class: TRANSCRIBED BY HAND from /usr/bin/time -v output produced on the deployment-sibling machine. Weaker than the four evidence files beside it, which are emitted by committed scripts and reproducible from them. Nothing here is re-derivable; it is a record, not a measurement anyone can repeat from this repository.
what_this_is: Resource cost of the item-10 evidence run. Metadata about the run that produced EVIDENCE_M1_M3_hgt/gat, EVIDENCE_M4 and EVIDENCE_M5 — not an M-fact, and not governed by BACKLOG 5.2's evidence schema, which covers what those four files record.
